as_of: branch claude/project-thread-n6c974 at 7f8b34c, 2026-11-15: the GPU rebake (8dae856) and its KTX2 maps (d758416) are in, Adriaen's final check on his desktop GPU and its fixes, the operator in camp_cargo (desk-at-night #166/#167 and the pin move), and the run-time stand-ins for the old bake removed

statuses.fixed: done and visible on the page now (needs_rebake true: the page part is in, the baked maps catch up at the next rebake)
statuses.waiting_rebake: done in a generator or the bake; it shows only after the GPU light (and jeep or ground) rebake
statuses.partly: part done; the note or followup says what is left (REVIEW-STATE.md lists it)
statuses.already_fixed: an earlier commit had fixed it; nothing changed in this round
statuses.blocked: cannot go further without the rebake, Adriaen's go-ahead or access this round did not have
statuses.deferred: Adriaen chose to leave it for now
statuses.pending_lead: left to the lead session to do by hand

fields: status; note (one sentence); commits (on this repo's branch unless prefixed desk-at-night@); needs_rebake (the GPU rebake must run before the change is complete on the page); lane (the fix lane or step that did it); followup (what a review follow-up changed, when there was one)

other_fixes.7b37067: props/lib/audit.py KNOWN gains jeep_expedition/GlassB back_only 2 and lowers Jeep overlaps 15 -> 6, so the rebake's jeep step no longer stops on the audit
other_fixes.5ca7672: sky.js and daylight.js fade the backdrop's top into the dome rim at every hour and sink the domes 0.5 m, so no seam shows from the track's open end since R2-161
other_fixes.4ec6013: layout.js gladeTurn uses wrapPi, and stale comments in core.js, ground.js, camp.html and CODING-STANDARDS are corrected

final_play_test.what: Adriaen's final check of the baked result on his desktop GPU (after the rebake 8dae856 and the KTX2 maps d758416): four items, then a review of their fixes

wedge.note: A black wedge (night) and a dark saw-tooth edge (day) at the campfire logs' feet: the ash ring and the level floor (R2-181) sat in the same plane. The Ring now draws with a decal polygon offset.

lab_camera.note: In the move lab the follow camera sat inside the hammock's sling. It now rises over cloth and other solids (016201d); after the review it searches a few times a second instead of every frame, eases its height, comes down only after the lower view stays clear, and always tries the orbit's top.

scenarios_tool.note: camp-scenarios found no tap menu on main, which has no #tapmenu; it now finds it on both.

canopy_haze.note: Fixed in 048edcf, Adriaen's pick "both tweaks" (2026-11-15): the backdrop and both sky domes stay at FAR (40 m) but are drawn FAR/30 times taller and higher, so they fill the same angles as at 30 m on main, so the painted trees look as they did on main, and by day the backdrop no longer fades into the sky at its top; the fade comes only with dusk, as on main. Same draws, triangles and programs.

operator_shadow.note: Sibling of the wedge found in the review: the operator's blob shadow (groundHeight + 0.012) z-fought with the level floor in every flat zone; it now has the same decal offset. The rain ripples, 2 mm under the floor, now sit 4 mm over it with the offset too.

R2-001.note: The sloth's pose (titanic, curl, idle) now goes through a new slothLife.pose hook (sloth/hooks.js, which is clips.js play), so it becomes the sloth's s.act and giveBack cross-fades it out. stopAllAction is gone from buddy.js.

R2-002.note: 1a0e5b5 already fixed this before this run. input.js give() now sends a wild sloth the flower-style feed() and never calls eatGift, so the s.trip.phase read in gifts.js is only reached for camp sloths, which always have a trip.

R2-003.note: jeep.js now sets PCFShadowMap, the type three 0.186 already switched to on the first shadow render.

R2-004.note: Added tools/check-imports.cjs, which links every camp module the way the browser does, with nothing run, and catches syntax errors, named imports with no matching export, missing plain models/ paths and stale KTX2 maps.
R2-004.followup: I added a probe job to check.yml as the reviewer described; it needs check, has timeout-minutes 10 and continue-on-error, runs npm ci, installs Playwright Chromium and runs npm run probe, then uploads the screenshot.

R2-005.note: The light step now removes the old .ktx2.txt of every map it rewrites, and it writes camp_lights.json without the ktx2 flag. bake_all.py checks for toktx before any step runs when the ktx step is included.

R2-006.note: watchFood now calls only a sloth that is awake at its own home and doing nothing else: not on a guest spot, not asleep, dozing, waking or mid-clip. errand() takes s.food at its start, so a bowl's place is never kept for a later errand.

R2-007.note: A new gift now ends the one being eaten: its food is removed, its eat-clip callback is dropped and the mouth card is hidden.

R2-008.note: headPose.js now starts the smile and the sleep blink only when they change (new flags op.anim.smiling and op.anim.shut), using paused actions instead of timeScale 0.

R2-009.note: While a gift is flying or he is still munching, the menu leaves out 'Give the ...' and gift() returns early (new helper munching() in talk.js).

R2-010.note: giveBack now defaults to clearSpot() and keeps the terrain height; the cuddle uses that default.

R2-011.note: The chores call toast(text, sound) and chores.js plays audio.js cue(sound) directly, so a repeated 'Got a log' still knocks.

R2-012.note: putDown now passes the yaw it already turned the sloth to into giveBack(at, yaw).

R2-013.note: weather.wet now starts at 1 when the saved or ?weather= mode is rain, so the camp loads already grey and raining.

R2-014.note: The sit now remembers whether it opened the door ('opened', set only when the door was not already open or opening).

R2-015.note: canvasTex has a new read option that asks for a willReadFrequently 2D context.

R2-016.note: worn() now runs only inside WORN_BOX: the box round the lane from the path's end to the trodden spot, padded by 1.15 m, plus the path's last 12 points, padded by 0.8 m.
R2-016.followup: The karaoke trip's merge (6cb99d4) widened WORN_BOX to also take in the karaoke road round the glade tree (glade.js ROUTE, padded by 1.25 m), and worn() now also wears that road. A follow-up after the merge review split it into wornPath and wornRoad: every test that decides whether the glade's stream draws a number reads wornPath alone, as before the road, and wornRoad only hides what was drawn, so the glade's flowers, plants and bushes stay where they were.

R2-017.note: New zsStep in naps.js draws the three z's for every sleeper and for the hammock napper, replacing hammockStep's own copy.

R2-018.note: sprite() now keeps one canvas texture per size and text in a Map; each sprite still gets its own material, so each can fade on its own.

R2-019.note: cs and csDir take an optional out vector. ik reach and handQuat, handPose, headPose, fidget, talk and walk now use module-level scratch vectors and quaternions, and the held sloth's arm bones are found once per hold. movers() fills a reused array of pairs; crowds report through add(position, radius), and sloths.js is updated to match. op.scr is removed: opApi.tapAt calls talk.js chestOnScreen() when asked.

R2-020.note: core.js PRE now starts groundSoil, groundShadow and groundNight at boot (the night map through loadLightMap, only for the expedition jeep). campGround.js buildGround() is now async and awaits them with the mask before it builds; main.js awaits it. ground.js takes textures or URLs (URLs remain as a fallback) and makes its three 1024x1024 live-shadow targets only on the first live cast, freeing them when a baked map arrives.

R2-224.note: Every bake pass now writes into one reused props-sized float image and one ground-sized image, removed at the end, and keeps only what it uses (the RGB mean, AO's first channel, or RGB for the thin cards' brighter side) as float32. save() removes each output image after saving it. bpy's Image.copy() turned out not to keep a generated image's pixels (tested), so each size is still filled at full size and scaled down, as before.

R2-225.note: The Cycles preview stills are now opt-in: --preview renders all of them, or only the comma-separated views given, and a plain run writes only the GLBs.

R2-226.note: props/lib/bake.py has a new pick_device(scene, choice); it picks OptiX, CUDA, Metal or HIP if one is there, otherwise the CPU, and prints which. bake_camp_lightmap.py calls it after its last reset() and takes --device auto|cpu|<backend>.

R2-021.note: New props/lib/audit.py, run by export_glb before it writes; for each object it prints triangles, enclosed %, player-hidden %, back-only, flips, degenerate and same-facing overlaps.

R2-227.note: In lib/mesh.py, cyl, ball and box now build their mesh with one bmesh op each, through a new primitive() helper. join() applies all the parts' modifiers with one convert and does one transform_apply after the join. outward() and bisect() are now bmesh helpers in lib/mesh.py, used by the jeep's prism, panel, duct and upper_half and by build_camp's rustic_seat, so nothing switches to edit mode.

R2-022.note: Added bake_camp_lightmap.py --preview: size 512, 8 samples and a 256 ground, on the CPU, written into apps/canopy-prototype/lmpreview/ (git ignores it).

R2-023.note: handsBusy(), freeHand() and settled() now live in operator/state.js, each documented once. fidget.js, headPose.js and talk.js all use them.

R2-024.note: CLAUDE.md now says camp-probe gives exact draws, triangles and programs but no frame times, and that frame times come from camp-gpu.cjs on a GPU machine.

R2-025.note: It marks the base64 models and KTX2 .txt files in apps/**/models, stickers/renderer/models and props/**/archive, plus *.glb and *.ktx2, as binary and linguist-generated, and marks layout_picked.json and package-lock.json as -diff. git grep now prints 'Binary file matches' for these files.

R2-026.note: package-lock.json is no longer gitignored and is committed; playwright is pinned to 1.63.0, whose Chromium 1243 is the build preinstalled in cloud sessions. npm run serve now uses the new tools/serve.cjs instead of npx http-server, the docs say npm ci, and props/requirements.txt pins bpy 5.3.0, numpy and pillow. export_casters now uses the shared CHROMIUM fallback, and CHROME still works.

R2-228.note: build_jeep.build() now writes models/jeep_expedition.txt and jeep_expedition_lod.txt through to_txt, and the script reads its arguments after -- when Blender runs it. bake_all.py has a jeep step before light that runs build_jeep.py --style <jeep> only when the GLB is missing or older than build_jeep.py or props/lib.

R2-027.note: Step 1: one tween in moves.js ({ p, q, lift, tip, sc }) now drives glide and move, and the jeep-sill clamber and the settle into a spot are now glides. postV(s) replaces the six typed copies of the post speed.

R2-028.note: New spots.js moveInto(s, g) and moveBack(s) replace the three hand-written copies of the move into a guest spot (day.js twice, saved.js once) and the reverse. leave() and giveBack() now use naps.js wakeUp, and placeHome and giveBack use yawQ.

R2-029.note: seatWatch is removed from the sloths' step. linger.js now claims the log you sit on: me.seat carries the log's index, and lingerStep claims or releases seatKey(i, i === 0) whenever me.seat changes, whoever changed it. campStep(dt) no longer takes a seat, and findSeats is gone.

R2-030.note: state.js setTrip(s, phase, fields) now starts every phase on a fresh trip record that keeps only the yaw.

R2-031.note: There is a new camp/events.js (EV.act, EV.food, EV.cheer, plus on and emit, each documented in its header).

R2-032.note: The tap menu buttons (camp/input.js) and the Put it back pill (activities/carry.js) now share one .tap-pill class in camp.html.

R2-033.note: Mostly already fixed by e66242c: jeepApi, seatApi and carApi are each built in their own module, and nothing adds members to jeepApi. carApi is not dead: audio/watch.js imports it.

R2-034.note: daylight.js (sm) and audio/watch.js now use util.js sstep(a, b, x) instead of THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(x, a, b), which gives the same curve, and lab.js imports $ from core.js. player.js onTrack is kept on purpose. camp/operator/ (fidget, handPose, buddy, cook, talk) still uses THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep.

R2-035.note: One ribbon(curve, {n, half, y, tex, alpha, tile, order}) now builds the footpath and the track's dirt and ruts.
R2-035.followup: The karaoke trip's merge (6cb99d4) lets ribbon() take half as a function of t (0..1 along the curve) as well as a number, so the karaoke road's ribbon widens from the glade path's width to its own; the curve each path's ribbon follows is now built once in layout.js as path.ribbon.

R2-036.note: layout.js now has three lists; PATHS entries carry id, curve, pts, half, lane and lead.
R2-036.followup: The karaoke trip's merge (6cb99d4) added a second PATHS entry, tripPath (the karaoke road), and the optional fields covers, segs, fade, wide and cut to the PATHS schema; layout.js now also gives each entry its ribbon curve (path.ribbon), and pathLane includes the road.

R2-037.note: Added util.js swap(src, ...[anchor, text]), which replaces like the old chains but warns once on the console when an anchor is missing.
R2-037.followup: The seven bare .replace() calls in patch() now go through it, with the warm-only anchors passed as optional pairs.

R2-038.note: Each blocker is now an object { at, r, walk, wild, tag } made by campProps.js addBlocker; dropBlockers(tag) replaces tentInside's splice.

R2-039.note: Added npm scripts for check, probe, probe:phone, gpu, gpu:phone, bake, bake:layout, bake:ktx, pack:sloth, pack:operator and stickers.

R2-229.note: The light bake's steps are now functions under main(): read_layout, build_lived_sets, build_scene, unwrap, add_occluders, add_ground, Lights, bake_light, write_maps and export_models.

R2-230.note: body(), expedition() and jeep_lod() now share one name for each common shape: LOWER_PROFILE, CAB_PROFILE with CAB_W and CAB_TAPER, windscreen() and windscreen_glass(), cabin_side_x(), wheel_arches(), flare(), bumpers(), winch() and snorkel() with SNORKEL_PATH, SNORKEL_SECS and SNORKEL_HEAD.

R2-231.note: build_lived.py now has one PROPS table of (name, builder, baked or textured, report note), in build order so the seeded stream is drawn as before. make(), BAKED, TEXTURED, the UV stripping and the report all come from it, and the header lists every prop.

R2-040.note: state.js PHASES lists every phase with its flags (lively, ground, lend, out), and LIVELY, GROUND, LENDABLE and OUT are made from it.

R2-041.note: The wood-stack cache key now covers the source from STACK_BOX to the end of _stack_block, the logs, the render settings and bpy.app.version_string.

R2-042.note: bake_all.py now serves the layout on a free 127.0.0.1 port, which it passes to the exporter as LAYOUT_PORT.

R2-043.note: The main fix was already on the branch (1a0e5b5): labButton.js returns early with ?campsloths=0, so no button and no ?lab load.

R2-044.note: step.js and jeepSeat.js now read pace.fast ?? 1, so the lab's Pause and Step (0) really pause.

R2-045.note: errand() now tests the kept want instead of the s.wantFood it had just cleared, so the lab's Get food never turns into an engine fix.

R2-046.note: places.js host(place, null) now deletes the entry, so hosted() is false after the operator unhosts and wander() no longer sends a sloth to a log he has left.

R2-047.note: wanderPoint() now measures distance on the ground plane against o.p, each sloth's world point, instead of o.o.position, which is local for sloths in the hammock, seat, jeep or tent.

R2-048.note: Each camp sloth keeps its cast factor as s.k, and the spots are no longer changed. spots.js sizeIn(s, spot) = spot.scale * s.k is used by placeHome and settleIn.

R2-049.note: The pot now remembers when its last bowl emptied it (soup.refill); putting that bowl back fills the pot again with one bowl left, as long as no water has gone in since.

R2-050.note: Frame-time delays go through util.js timers(): the chores queue their EV.cheer emits and soup and talk use it, so these paths have no setTimeout left.
R2-050.followup: Soup sends the second word 0.7 s after the first, with a new skip field so it goes to the second-nearest sloth. cheer() runs at once with no setTimeout, EV.cheer no longer has delay or gap, and the events.js header is updated.

R2-051.note: With ?lived=0 there is no crate, so drink and cook are left out of his weighted picks.

R2-052.note: The Detail button now builds new URL(location.href), deletes 'detail' and calls location.replace, the same way the Light button handles ?lm=.

R2-053.note: ?pos, ?yaw and ?pitch were already checked in 136323e, and an empty ?time= (or an empty stored value) now counts as missing, so the time falls back to the saved hour or 12 instead of midnight.

R2-054.note: When a second (or later) finger lands, lookStart clears every pending hold timer and marks each finger as pinching. lookEnd skips the tap for a pinching finger, so neither feed() nor tap() fires during or after a pinch.

R2-055.note: The keydown listener now ignores events whose target is inside an input, select or textarea, or is contentEditable. keyup and blur still clear keys as before.
R2-055.followup: Now a focused range slider or select keeps only the Arrow, Page, Home and End keys.

R2-056.note: context.js now remembers the saved values that ?sound=0 and ?station= replace for the visit. keep() writes saved(), which puts those values back, and any setting the viewer changes on the page (mute, the Sound button, the station) is their own again through own(key) and is stored as usual.

R2-057.note: The safety net in main.js (perfStep) ignores the first second; it takes the median frame interval of the next second as the target, capped at 1/30 s so a phone that is slow from the start still counts as slow.

R2-058.note: In core.js, glb() now throws Error(url + ' ' + status) when the response is not ok.
R2-058.followup: The inline load-error script in camp.html is now a block with a const loadFailed, so it no longer makes one; the behaviour is unchanged.

R2-059.note: The lab's path line now has one fixed buffer of 128 points with DynamicDrawUsage. drawPath() writes the points in place without making new vectors and calls setDrawRange(0, n).

R2-060.note: The bare setTimeout is replaced by a pending close { k, t: 0.7 } kept in jeepSeat.js.

R2-061.note: shared/fur.js now reads each texture's pixels once and keeps them in a WeakMap keyed by the image, so each animal's fur mask uses its own texture. getImageData also runs once per image instead of once per geometry. npm run sync-shared rewrote the six copies, and check-shared passes.

R2-062.note: export_casters.cjs now uses launch, routeThree and watch from camp-page.cjs, and exits 1 without writing layout_picked.json if the page logged any error.

R2-063.note: After its quality loop, stk_post.py stops with SystemExit if a still sticker is 100 KB or more, and stk_anim_post.py does the same at 500 KB or more for animated stickers.

R2-232.note: export_casters.cjs now collects page errors; if any came in, it writes nothing and exits 1. bake_ground.py reads hammock, glade, tent and track with L[...] and keeps .get only for the optional entry.

R2-233.note: The probe's program-name regex now has a single backslash; most camp materials have no name, so it falls back to the shader type (MeshLambertMaterial:hash and so on instead of ?:hash).

R2-234.note: build_camp.py --style now writes to props/camp/out/camp_<style>.glb, which is git-ignored.

R2-235.note: build_lived, build_fire and build_laundry run on their own now default to props/lived/<name>_preview.glb, which is git-ignored.

R2-064.note: day.js lifeStop calls it.return(), which runs each script's finally: cook gives the pail back (new soupChore cook.returnPail) and clears cooking, join sets cd.join, and sleep puts him at the tent door.

R2-065.note: zStep now draws z's for any sloth that is dozing and asleep, including Hibi, so it gets them in the hammock and when it naps in the clearing. hammockStep now only swings the hammock, and the hammock's own z set (hammock.zz/zk) is gone.

R2-066.note: The fixed 1/60 was already gone, because R2-027 made the line slides pass their frame's sd.

R2-067.note: leave() now always sets s.once = null, not only for gifts; the card-game mate search also leaves out sloths that are roused or have a stretch or bite still pending (q.roused, q.once).

R2-068.note: The 'finished' listener is gone. op.anim.wave holds the time left, and poseHead counts it down.

R2-069.note: The pail spot's take condition now also checks canister.pail.visible; when the pail is gone, its why line says "He's fetching water already 💧".

R2-070.note: main.js now applies ?pos, ?yaw and ?pitch before the build list. daylight.js places the moon along the way you face at the start (me.yaw) instead of from your position toward the fire, which also works with ?pos=0,0 and with ?yaw.

R2-071.note: While a pointer is down on the time slider, showTime leaves the slider's value alone.

R2-072.note: main.js starts document.fonts.load for '700 46px Fredoka' and '600 22px Fredoka' before the build.

R2-073.note: loadLightMap now takes { ktx: false }, and core.js passes it for ?lm=4k, so the 4K PNGs load with no 404s (checked with the probe).

R2-074.note: shared/fur.js: the warm term is wrapped in if (uWarm > 0.0); A new opt-in lod option gives each shell mesh a second geometry with 2 layers at the same fur length (userData.furLod). camp sloth/life.js furStep shows every layer within 3 m, 2 layers from 3 to 8 m and none beyond, with a 0.3 m margin so it does not flicker at the edges.

R2-075.note: groundHeight now returns the dip straight away inside flatIn, which is RC - 0.8 or the inner edge of the nearest root mound.

R2-076.note: Each backdrop leaf cluster is now painted once per layer colour into a small sprite, 4 shapes each from their own stream (lcg 4243), and stamped scaled with drawImage.

R2-077.note: daylight.js hides the day dome under a fully opaque night dome, and the moon's fade-in, once swallowed by a trailing comment, is code again.
R2-077.followup: A trailing comment had swallowed the moon's opacity statement, so the moon stayed at opacity 0. daylight.js now has one statement per line, with the comment on a line of its own, and the moon's opacity is code again.

R2-078.note: The canopy leaves are now split at 5 m, so the eye-height band and the canopy above are separate sectors.

R2-079.note: The mist banks now use atmosphere.js's billboard pool, which is now exported.

R2-080.note: table.js has a new buildPlaces(). main.js calls it through sloths.js buildSlothPlaces right after buildChores, so after the glade, the tent walls and the chores have added their blockers.

R2-081.note: keep() now builds its change key from where each sloth sleeps and whether it is dozing, not from the seconds it has left.

R2-082.note: forest.js now exports heroWood (the big trees' wood mesh) and trunkR(y). trunkR is built from the same foot and top radii as the trunk's cylinder, so poses.js no longer keeps a copy of the formula.

R2-083.note: slothsStep now calls camera.getWorldDirection once per frame instead of once per sloth.

R2-084.note: Most of this was already done in R2-019 (50b1e89): the arms were cached on the first carried frame, but a lookup closure was still made every frame. buddy.js pickUp now finds both upper-arm bones once and stores them in op.carry.arms, so handPose only reads them.

R2-085.note: In audio/watch.js, opLast and meLast are held vectors filled by copy; the sloths' and the operator's last state is updated field by field.

R2-086.note: In weather.js a respawned drop now writes its four values directly, and a light shower moves, uploads (addUpdateRange) and draws (setDrawRange) only its share of the streaks.

R2-087.note: The radio's note sprites are hidden while the radio is off; at Detail Low, fireLight is still created (chores.js and fireStep write to it) but is not added to the scene, and detail is fixed until reload, so the light count never changes.

R2-088.note: The per-frame shadowStep, with shadowTick and shadowN, is gone. campGround.js castSunShadows() runs once after the build.

R2-089.note: player.js now reuses module scratch vectors for fwd, right, wish, the next position and onTrack's nearest point.

R2-090.note: input.js has setFov() and zoomTo(add), which holds the -20..+6 clamp; the wheel and a pinch only change the camera's fov, and resize() still sizes the canvas and then calls setFov.

R2-091.note: daylight.js sets rayMat.visible = opacity > 0.002, which covers the clearing's 7 shafts and the glade's beams at night and in rain. lanterns.js sets flames.visible and glows.visible to dusk > 0.001 and stops writing their point buffers by day.

R2-092.note: Only the three cabin doors (y-axis) count as moving for the cabin light and its shadow-map redraw, so the hood's swing no longer sets shadowMap.needsUpdate.

R2-093.note: jeep.js keeps doorList and cabinDoors once and loops without closures. lightStep returns early when no cabin door moved and the light has reached its target; cab now snaps to its target within 0.002, and a final shadow redraw is forced when it does. sloth/body.js fills the lantern positions and strengths once, at the first hang(). warmStep(fl, dusk) sets only the fire's strength and uWarm, and main.js no longer passes lanternGlow. lanterns.js update is a plain loop over a fixed array, with the sway unchanged. car.js resets the jeep's position once when the engine stops, then stops writing it every frame.

R2-094.note: The floor's opaque_fragment line now reuses shd and computes the same value, while SHADE() stays for shadeOn.

R2-095.note: The inside/bare/trackDist reject now runs before sample and nearThing. nearThing, flowerField and clump are plain loops with no map or spread. sample draws no random numbers, so the same plants come out in the same order: the instanced plants count is 1573 before and after.

R2-096.note: The light-mapped props' hook in campProps.js lnight now replaces three's lights_fragment_maps include with nothing.

R2-097.note: The trait cards, Figgy's leaf and the plain-coloured parts now share one 256x256 atlas and one material, and the parts on each bone are merged into one mesh.

R2-098.note: ground.js builds the glade's plants (extra) as a second InstancedMesh on the same material, with its own bounds and frustum culling on; the clearing's mesh is culled too.

R2-099.note: These no longer allocate per frame: the camp step counts sloths that are out with a loop; walkStep checks other walkers through a heed() helper and uses scratch vectors; places.js has eachMover(visit), which the operator's walk uses (movers() stays for camp-scenarios); and the pose helpers write into a pose that each slide owns (newPose).

R2-100.note: addTargets(kind, items, make) now takes the owner's array and a make function, and allTargets refills one shared array.
R2-100.followup: The karaoke trip's merge (6cb99d4) added an optional tap() to a target: a thing with one obvious use (trip.js's karaoke sign) runs it at once on a tap instead of opening the menu.

R2-101.note: atmosphere.js now exports pool(); the fire chore's sparks (one pool of 24 tinted 0xffb35a, renderOrder 5) and the soup's bubbles (one pool of 10, renderOrder 2) use it.

R2-102.note: Before compileAsync, main.js shows every hidden non-light object, starts the compile, which builds its programs synchronously, and hides them again before awaiting.
